title: [AF-9287] test(hotel-order-status): add unit tests for order status transform and validation utils
body:
JIRA link: https://borobudur.atlassian.net/browse/AF-9287

## Description & Technical Solution

Add unit tests for the hotel order status transform function and validation utility methods to ensure correctness of status mapping and input validation.

### Changes

#### Tests
- Added **GetHotelOrderStatus.transform.test.ts** — unit tests for `getHotelOrderStatusTransform` covering success response, unknown API code, unknown order status code, and unauthorized error scenarios
- Added **hotel-order-status.test.ts** — unit tests for `isHotelOrderStatusValid`, `isHotelOrderCodeValid`, and `isHotelOrderFailedReasonValid` utility functions with parameterized test cases covering valid values, invalid strings, null, undefined, and empty inputs

### Impact

Improves test coverage for the hotel order status domain. No functional changes to existing code.

title: [AF-9287] feat(hotel-order-status): create hotel order status service boilerplate
body:
JIRA link: https://borobudur.atlassian.net/browse/AF-9287

## Description & Technical Solution

Introduce the `GetHotelOrderStatus` service boilerplate under `Order/services/` to support hotel order status polling, and extend the hotel order entity layer with new API code types, failed reason types, and corresponding validation utilities.

### Changes

#### New Features
- Created `GetHotelOrderStatus` service with full scaffolding under `Order/services/GetHotelOrderStatus/`:
  - **Contract types** (`GetHotelorderstatus.contract.ts`) — API response type definitions for success/error responses
  - **Transform function** (`GetHotelOrderStatus.transform.ts`) — transforms raw API response into structured order status data with code validation, status mapping, and failed reason extraction
  - **Service entry point** (`GetHotelOrderStatus.ts`) — fetch-based service with abort signal support (currently using mock data with commented-out real implementation)
  - **TypeScript types** (`GetHotelOrderStatus.types.ts`) — service argument and response type definitions
  - **Mock data** (`__mocks__/GetHotelOrderStatus.mock.ts`) — mock responses for success, unauthorized, and not-found scenarios
  - **Sample JSON** (`success.json`, `error.json`) — reference API response payloads

#### Enhancement
- Extended `HotelOrderAPICodeType` with concrete union values: `NOT_FOUND`, `SUCCESS`, `UNAVAILABLE`, `UNAUTHORIZED`, `SYSTEM_ERROR`, `SYSTEM_UNAVAILABLE`
- Added `HotelOrderFailedReasonType` (`OTHERS`) and `HotelCreateOrderCodeType` (`SUCCESS`) to hotel order entity types
- Added `MAPPING_HOTEL_ORDER_DETAIL_CODE`, `MAPPING_HOTEL_ORDER_DETAIL_FAILED_REASON_CODE`, and `MAPPING_HOTEL_CREATE_ORDER_CODE` constant mappings
- Added `isHotelOrderCodeValid` and `isHotelOrderFailedReasonValid` type guard utilities in `Order/utils/hotel-order-status.ts`

#### Others
- Fixed typo: renamed `isHoteltOrderStatusValid` → `isHotelOrderStatusValid` across `hotel-order-status.ts` and `GetHotelOrderLists.transform.ts`
- Removed `FAILED_DOUBLE_BOOKING` from `HotelOrderStatusCodeType` and its constant mapping
- Removed unused comment from `hotel-order-list/constant.ts`

### Impact

Adds the foundation for the hotel order status polling feature. The typo fix in `isHotelOrderStatusValid` affects `GetHotelOrderLists.transform.ts` but introduces no functional changes.

- [ ] Bug fix
- [x] Enhancement
- [x] New feature
